name: Powers of the Void
summary: A stolen tome draws Drusilla La Salle's attention in Northshire. Powers of the Void was kept in a restricted wing of Northshire Abbey's library until a novice took it while defecting to the Defias Brotherhood. Drusilla seeks its recovery for her own study of dark magic.

sections.title: A Restricted Northshire Text
sections.body: Powers of the Void was kept behind guarded shelves in Northshire Abbey's library. The abbey archives hold holy scripture and clerical records, along with scholarly works on shadow and nether energies. The tome was presumably penned by the archmage Khadgar. Because its subject was dangerous, abbey authorities kept the book under guard and away from casual visitors. That barred Northshire's warlock mentor, Drusilla La Salle, from browsing it without drawing the priesthood's suspicion.

sections.title: Defias Theft and Recovery
sections.body: A Northshire novice carried the tome away while abandoning his vows to join the Defias Brotherhood. As he fled into the neighboring vineyards, he took several valuable volumes from the abbey. Drusilla sends promising warlock initiates into the Defias bandit camp to recover the book from their tents. She wants the dark knowledge for her own study, and the effort tests whether an initiate has the nerve to bind otherworldly demons.

faq.q: What is Powers of the Void?
aliases: what is powers of the void
faq.answer: Powers of the Void is a rare occult book about shadow and nether energies, believed to have been penned by the archmage Khadgar. It was kept in a restricted wing of Northshire Abbey's library before it was stolen.

faq.q: Why was the book locked up in Northshire Abbey?
aliases: why was it in the abbey
why did the priests have it
faq.answer: Northshire Abbey keeps historic archives, including dangerous texts on illicit magic. Books about Void energies and demonology are locked away to keep novices and wayward practitioners from abusing them.

faq.q: How did the Defias Brotherhood get the book?
faq.answer: A Northshire Abbey novice defected to the Defias Brotherhood and took several valuable volumes from the restricted library. He hid them in the bandit camp in the Northshire vineyards.

faq.q: Why does Drusilla La Salle want Powers of the Void?
faq.answer: Drusilla La Salle is Northshire's warlock mentor and wants the tome's knowledge for her own dark craft. She could not enter the abbey's secure library without raising suspicion.

faq.q: What does retrieving the tome prove to Drusilla?
aliases: why do warlocks need the book
faq.answer: Retrieving the tome tests whether an initiate has the nerve to bind demons. Drusilla uses that test before teaching them to summon their first imp.

angles.text: As a warlock, retrieving the stolen tome tests whether you have the will to earn instruction in summoning an imp.
As a human, you can see that Northshire's Holy Order keeps dangerous magical records alongside clerical texts, hidden from novice eyes.
